the patient on [**2128-2-16**], but she had been taken to the OR.  We
returned today to re-attempt the bedside swallow evaluation and
rule out aspiration while eating and drinking.  RN reported that

upright in the bed in the MICU.

output was limited to [**12-13**] word responses, and intermittently
intelligible.  Vocal quality was quiet and weak.

present.

Tongue protruded midline.  Adequate lingual ROM and strength.
Functional labial ROM and strength.  Adequate buccal tone.
Symmetrical palatal elevation.  Gag deferred.

residue following POs administered.  Swallow trigger present.

vocal quality.  No throat clearing, coughing, or choking.  O2s
remained stable at 94-95%.

status.  Patient required encouragement to take small amounts of
